Definition: Elijah, the name of the famous prophet and of two other Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elijah is the name of the famous prophet and of two other Israelites. In 1 Kings 17:1, the text says "And Elijah the Tishbite." The life behind the name is told on the Elijah People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elijah matters because God knows His people by name, and Elijah is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
